name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Copper, $36k, and $41k go with Hertz, Otis, and Tesla, in some order.
If either $51k does not go with Copper or Hertz goes with $51k, then either Otis goes with Carbon or Copper goes with Tesla.
Carbon, Titanium, and Tungsten go with Edison, Hertz, and Tesla, in some order.
Either Watt goes with $46k or Hertz goes with Carbon.
Tesla's budget is between Hertz and the engineer using Carbon.
Hertz goes with either Carbon or Titanium.
